review_candidates.description: Description RIVR builds legged robots for real-world last-mile delivery. Our Austin site is RIVR’s presence in the Americas and is growing quickly — including production support coverage for the wider RIVR manufacturing operation. The RIVR IT & Security team owns the technology behind all of it: office and manufacturing IT, engineering and business platforms (PLM, ERP, MES), the production systems, and information security. We are looking for a Support Engineer based in Austin to provide on-site technical coverage for the office and to anchor the Americas end of our globally distributed team. This role combines hands-on support and infrastructure work with production support: you will keep the Austin office and lab running, provision and support hardware for a growing team, and own the Austin end of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation — closing an 18-hour coverage window that runs from Shanghai through Zurich to Austin. You will work as part of a small, distributed team alongside senior engineers in Zurich and a counterpart in Shanghai. Because the team is lean and the time zones are wide, your coverage matters: when you are on shift, you are the person keeping RIVR’s systems — including the production line — healthy for the Americas hours and beyond. Key job responsibilities Austin office & lab IT. Keep the Austin office and lab systems running: end-user support, networking, and local infrastructure for a growing site. Provisioning & equipment. Image and provision laptops, desktops, and lab hardware; manage local equipment, accessories, and ordering. Production support coverage. Provide Americas-hours coverage for production-critical systems, monitoring the line and responding to incidents while Zurich and Shanghai are offline. On-call. Own the Austin end of the distributed follow-the-sun on-call rotation, closing the 18-hour window and handing off to Shanghai. Operate & maintain. Run and maintain the RIVR-specific systems built by the wider team; apply IaC-managed changes, follow runbooks, and contribute monitoring/reliability improvements. Local hands. Be the on-site presence for physical infrastructure work in Austin — cabling, hardware, installs and support Amazon integration at the site with guidance from Zurich. A day in the life You come online as Zurich is wrapping up and pick up on-call for the Americas. You clear a couple of tickets from Austin staff, provision a laptop for a new hire, and check in on the production-line monitoring while the other sites are offline. Mid-day you apply an infrastructure change prepared by the Zurich engineer and help set up a new lab bench. Before you log off you review overnight alerts to hand a clean state to Shanghai. Your shift is what keeps coverage unbroken across the 18-hour window. Hands-on experience with AWS Cloud (compute, networking, IAM) — strongly preferred. Exposure to monitoring/alerting tooling and structured incident response. We are a market-leading independent power producer and service provider, serving utilities, corporations, industries, communities, institutions, and investors with reliable, low-carbon energy solutions that help meet growing demand. From developing and building scalable wind (onshore and offshore), solar, storage (battery and pumped storage hydro), smart EV charging, microgrids, green hydrogen, and transmission projects, to maximizing performance and profitability through skilled operations and maintenance and innovative asset optimization, our teams deliver expert solutions along the entire value chain—from origination to commercial operation. Be a part of an innovative and collaborative team environment that fosters our goal of delivering renewable solutions to lead the transition to a sustainable energy future. Benefits & Perks EDF power solutions offers best-in-class employee benefits, including the following: Competitive bonus incentives. This position is eligible for our annual bonus program. Comprehensive health coverage. We provide health & wellness coverage for employees and their eligible dependents. Rewarding RRSP/DPSP. We provide a generous matching contribution. We Are Also Proud To Offer Favorable paid time off programs. Rewarding learning & career development and advancement opportunities. Supportive mentorship & buddy programs. Salary Range : The full pay range for this role is $95,200 to $158,700 annually, and the good faith estimated starting pay for this position upon hire is $114,300 to $133,350 annually. We generally base our salary decisions on factors including but not limited to, relevant work and leadership experience, education, demonstrated performance, internal equity, and in some cases, geographic location. Scope of Job : The Project Estimation Manager will play a critical role in driving the successful development, evaluation, and implementation of renewable energy projects within the Project Estimation team, which is part of the broader Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Technical Services (EPCTS) department. The successful candidate will be a recognized subject matter expert and strategic owner of the end-to-end estimation process and will be accountable for the quality, accuracy, and strategic value of project evaluations that directly drive investment decisions, portfolio prioritization, and long-term project success. The Project Estimation Manager will lead the evaluation and aggregation of technical project assumptions for projects under development, encompassing construction and equipment costs, ongoing operational expenses, and impacts on energy production. The Project Estimation Manager will be accountable to ensure that project investment decisions are informed by the most reliable and up-to-date information available. This will include setting the analytical standard for late-stage investment decisions, proactively identifying gaps or risks in the estimation framework, and driving structural improvements across tools, processes, and cross-functional workflows with minimal direction. The Project Estimation Manager will indirectly guide the work of analysts and cross-functional contributors through coaching, technical direction, and review, without formal supervisory authority. The Project Estimation Manager will provide recommendations that inform broader EPCT department strategy. In addition to technical expertise, the Project Estimation Manager will promote efforts to enhance and standardize estimation processes, tools, and systems across the EPCT department. This will include identifying opportunities for innovation, implementing best practices, and driving cross-functional collaboration to improve efficiency, accuracy, and overall project outcomes. As a key contributor to the success of renewable energy projects, the Project Estimation Manager will serve as a trusted advisor to leadership, providing strategic insights and recommendations to optimize project feasibility, cost-effectiveness, and long-term performance. This role requires a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and a commitment to advancing the company’s mission of delivering sustainable energy solutions. It is desired that the successful candidate also be able to provide functional coverage and technical continuity for the Senior Data Solutions Engineer during periods of absence or elevated workload demand. As such, the ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in data architecture and software engineering in addition to deep renewable energy project expertise. A Propos De Nous Depuis 1987, EDF solutions électriques fournit des solutions d'énergie propre aux États-Unis, au Canada et au Mexique. Nous sommes un producteur d'énergie indépendant et un fournisseur de services de premier plan sur le marché, offrant aux services publics, aux entreprises, aux industries, aux communautés, aux institutions et aux investisseurs des solutions énergétiques fiables et à faible émission de carbone qui aident à répondre à une demande croissante. Faites partie d'une équipe collaborative et innovante qui s'engage à fournir des solutions renouvelables pour promouvoir la transition vers un avenir énergétique durable. Des opportunités d'apprentissage, de développement de carrière et d'avancement gratifiantes. Des programmes de mentorat et de jumelage. Nous basons généralement nos décisions salariales sur des facteurs tels que, entre autres, l'expérience professionnelle et le leadership, la formation, les performances démontrées, l'équité interne et, dans certains cas, la situation géographique. Objectif de l'emploi : Cette personne jouera un rôle essentiel dans la réussite du développement, de l'évaluation et de la mise en œuvre de projets liés aux énergies renouvelables au sein de l'équipe d'estimation des projets, qui fait partie du département plus large « Ingénierie, Approvisionnement, Construction et Services techniques » (EPCTS). Cette personne sera l'expert reconnu dans son domaine et le.la responsable stratégique du processus d’estimation de bout en bout ; il.elle sera garante de la qualité, de la précision et de la valeur stratégique des évaluations de projets qui orientent directement les décisions d’investissement, la hiérarchisation du portefeuille et la réussite à long terme des projets. Cette personne dirigera l’évaluation et la synthèse des hypothèses techniques relatives aux projets en cours de développement, notamment les coûts de construction et d’équipement, les dépenses d’exploitation courantes et les impacts sur la production d’énergie. Cette personne sera responsable de l’estimation des projets et aura pour mission de veiller à ce que les décisions d’investissement soient fondées sur les informations les plus fiables et les plus récentes disponibles. Cela impliquera de définir la norme analytique applicable aux décisions d’investissement en phase avancée, d’identifier de manière proactive les lacunes ou les risques dans le cadre d’estimation, et de piloter des améliorations structurelles au niveau des outils, des processus et des flux de travail interfonctionnels avec un minimum d’encadrement. Cette personne guidera indirectement le travail des analystes et des collaborateurs interfonctionnels par le biais d’un accompagnement, d’une orientation technique et d’un contrôle, sans exercer d’autorité hiérarchique formelle. Il.elle formulera des recommandations qui éclaireront la stratégie globale du département EPCT. Outre son expertise technique, cette personne encouragera les efforts visant à améliorer et à normaliser les processus, les outils et les systèmes d’estimation au sein du département EPCT. Cela impliquera d’identifier les opportunités d’innovation, de mettre en œuvre les meilleures pratiques et de favoriser la collaboration interfonctionnelle afin d’améliorer l’efficacité, la précision et les résultats globaux des projets.
